platform: desktop (Joplin 3.7.10 on Linux, two clients/users with Joplin Server)
description: With a shared folder, a note published by one user cannot be unpublished by the other user.
expected_report: User A shares a folder with user B, B accepts. One of them publishes a note in the shared folder. The other user tries to unpublish it and cannot. Expected: the share owner can unpublish any published note in the shared folder, including notes published by a recipient.
difficulty: Two app instances / accounts on screen, Retina 3024x1866, the key difference is which account performs the action.
